name: Stonks
look: Meme Man, a smooth, bald, gray 3D head, wears a black suit and blue tie and stands with arms crossed in front of a blue stock ticker board. A glowing orange arrow shoots upward behind him over the white word "stonks".
use: Celebrates a dumb or tiny "financial win" with mock pride. The caption describes a bad money move, a questionable shortcut or a trivial gain, and Meme Man presents it as savvy investing.
slots: the dumb money move or tiny win (caption above)
examples: Spent $30 on gas driving to the store where milk is 20 cents cheaper

origin: Features Meme Man, the smooth 3D-rendered head from surreal memes, posed before a stock ticker with "stonks", a deliberate misspelling of stocks.
